Validation Rule: The Zoho item must actually be stocked and tracked.
Zoho Error Message: Error: Zoho item must be 'Inventory' type to track on Shopify.

Validation Rule: The item (or primary group item) MUST have a filled description field
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR]: Missing Description. Items must have detailed content before syncing to Shopify.

Validation Rule: The item must have an image file attached in Zoho.
Zoho Error Message: Error: Zoho item is missing an image. Shopify products must have an image.

Validation Rule: The item's rate/price must be strictly greater than $0.00.
Zoho Error Message: Error: Zoho item has a price of 0. Shopify products must have a valid price.

Validation Rule: If a product is Standalone it is not allowed to have data in the Var 1/2/3 - Name columns.
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR] Data Mismatch: Single products should not have variant names/values.

Validation Rule: Catches if multiple Standalone products share the exact same Item Name.
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR] Duplicate Title: Please provide a 'Shopify Collection' name to group these as variants.

Validation Rule: All variants grouped under the same Shopify Collection must have the exact same option dimensions.
Zoho Error Message: Conflict: Inconsistent option names in group...

Validation Rule: Rejects SKUs that are already attached to a different Product Title on Shopify.
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR] SKU Collision: SKU [X] is already linked to a different Title on Shopify.

Validation Rule: Validates via Pillow that image original dimensions map to an aspect ratio between 0.8 and 1.2.
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR]: Aspect Ratio Mismatch (Ratio: [X.XX]). Image is too [Wide/Tall]. Please crop to a 1:1 square in Zoho and re-sync.

Validation Rule: Validates via Pillow that original image dimensions are at least 800x800px to ensure sharpness.
Zoho Error Message: [ERROR]: Image Resolution Too Low (Size: {width}x{height}px). Minimum required is 800px for Shopify zoom functionality. Please re-sync a higher quality image.

Validation Rule: Catches any GraphQL API userErrors rejected by Shopify.
